notes: After every new instance in both services has passed startup checks, drain all queued offer.queued events before the coordinated cutover. Then switch customer and notifier together. The drain prevents offers emitted before the consent rule change from taking effect afterward; the atomic switch prevents old customer instances from continuing to create legacy-consent effects and prevents a failed notifier rollout from leaving a mixed estate. The offer.queued event shape and customer schema are unchanged. Roll back both services together to the previous versions if either service fails.
